    select  record_id,
            TRIM(FLATTEN(REGEXP_SPLIT("monitoringpurpose", chr(59), 'ALL', 999))) as oneLanguage
    from    dataset_44489."monitoringpurpose"
),

    select  IL.record_id,

            count(*) as quantity
    from    IndividualLanguage IL

from    dataset_44489."monitoringpurpose" M

QC Description: gwChemicalMonitoringReference Must be reported for every RBD with designated groundwater bodies.
Message: gwChemicalMonitoringReference Must be reported for every RBD with designated groundwater bodies. [RF402_WFD]
Expression:
WITH
-- =========================================================
-- 1. Country check computed ONCE.
-- =========================================================
country_check AS (
    SELECT 1 AS is_wfd
    FROM dataset_37016."country" C
    WHERE C.countryCode   = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
      AND C.reportingType = 'WFD'
),
-- =========================================================
-- 2. Identify RBDs that have at least one valid GWB.
--    Positive matching: safer and more efficient than
--    the original NOT IN (RBDs without GWBs) approach.
-- =========================================================
rbds_with_gwb AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.thematicIdIdentifier AS euRBDCode
    FROM dataset_37016."riverbasindistrictwfd" r
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewfd" m
        ON  r.thematicIdIdentifier       = m.relatedZoneIdentifier
        AND m.thematicIdIdentifierScheme = 'euGroundWaterBodyCode'
        AND m.statusCode                 IN ('valid', 'stable')
    WHERE r.statusCode   IN ('valid', 'stable')
      AND r.countrycode  = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
)
-- =========================================================
-- RESULT: RBDs that have GWBs but are missing
-- gwChemicalMonitoringReference. [RF402_WFD]
-- =========================================================
SELECT MP.record_id, MP."eurbdcode"
FROM dataset_44489."monitoringprogrammes" MP
INNER JOIN rbds_with_gwb r          -- only RBDs confirmed to have GWBs
        ON MP."eurbdcode" = r.euRBDCode
CROSS JOIN country_check            -- blocks result if not WFD country
WHERE (MP."gwChemicalMonitoringReference" IS NULL
    OR COALESCE(MP."gwChemicalMonitoringReference", '') = '')

Message: The MonitoringProgrammes table must have one record for each of the river basin districts being reported (i.e. where dcMetadata.includesMonitoringData = 'yes'). Values: {%identifiers%} . Number of invalid values: {%numberofrecords%}  [T401]
Expression:
SELECT X.record_id
    ,CASE 
        WHEN LENGTH(X.ids) > 4000
            THEN CONCAT (
                    LEFT(X.ids, CASE 
                            WHEN POSITION(',' IN REVERSE(LEFT(X.ids, 3997))) > 0
                                THEN 3997 - POSITION(',' IN REVERSE(LEFT(X.ids, 3997)))
                            ELSE 3997
                            END)
                    ,'...'
                    )
        ELSE X.ids
        END AS identifiers
    ,X.numberofrecords
FROM (
    SELECT MIN(record_id) AS record_id
        ,listagg(dc.euRBDCode, ', ') AS ids
        ,COUNT(*) AS numberofrecords
    FROM dataset_37014."dcmetadata" DC
    WHERE DC."includesmonitoringdata" = 'yes'
        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dataset_44489."monitoringprogrammes" mp
            WHERE mp."euRBDCode" = dc."euRBDCode"
            )
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
    ) X

QC Description: The chemicalMatrix value must be reported if and only if chemical monitoring occurs.
Message: The chemicalMatrix value must be reported if and only if chemical monitoring occurs. [R400_WFD]
Expression:
WITH
-- =========================================================
-- 1. Country check computed ONCE.
-- =========================================================
country_check AS (
	SELECT 1 AS is_wfd
	FROM dataset_37016."country" C
	WHERE C.countryCode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
		AND C.reportingType = 'WFD'
),
-- =========================================================
-- 2. Spatial flag computed ONCE from dcmetadata.
-- =========================================================
spatial_flag AS (
	SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN includesspatialdata = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS includes_spatial
	FROM dataset_37014."dcmetadata"
),
-- =========================================================
-- 3. GWB monitoring sites via two reporting paths
--    gated by spatial_flag:
--    Path A (includes_spatial = 1): monitoringsite →
--            relatedzonewfd (euGroundWaterBodyCode)
--    Path B (includes_spatial = 0): monitoringsitewfd →
--            relatedzonewfd (euGroundWaterBodyCode)
-- =========================================================
gwb_sites_spatial AS (
	SELECT DISTINCT MS."thematicididentifier" AS euMonitoringSiteCode
	FROM dataset_37015."monitoringsite" MS
	JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewfd" rz ON rz.thematicIdIdentifier = MS."featureofinterestidentifier"
		AND rz.thematicIdIdentifierScheme = 'euGroundWaterBodyCode'
	CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
	WHERE rz.countrycode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
		AND rz.statusCode IN ('valid', 'stable')
		AND sf.includes_spatial = 1
),
gwb_sites_ref AS (
	SELECT DISTINCT MR.thematicIdIdentifier AS euMonitoringSiteCode
	FROM dataset_37016."monitoringsitewfd" MR
	JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewfd" rz ON rz.thematicIdIdentifier = MR.relatedzoneidentifier
		AND rz.thematicIdIdentifierScheme = 'euGroundWaterBodyCode'
	CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
	WHERE MR.countrycode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
		AND rz.statusCode IN ('valid', 'stable')
		AND sf.includes_spatial = 0
),
all_gwb_sites AS (
	SELECT euMonitoringSiteCode FROM gwb_sites_spatial
	UNION ALL
	SELECT euMonitoringSiteCode FROM gwb_sites_ref
),
-- =========================================================
-- 4. SWB monitoring sites via two reporting paths
--    gated by spatial_flag:
--    Path A (includes_spatial = 1): monitoringsite →
--            relatedzonewfd (euSurfaceWaterBodyCode)
--    Path B (includes_spatial = 0): monitoringsitewfd →
--            relatedzonewfd (euSurfaceWaterBodyCode)
-- =========================================================
swb_sites_spatial AS (
	SELECT DISTINCT MS."thematicididentifier" AS euMonitoringSiteCode
	FROM dataset_37015."monitoringsite" MS
	JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewfd" rz ON rz.thematicIdIdentifier = MS."featureofinterestidentifier"
		AND rz.thematicIdIdentifierScheme = 'euSurfaceWaterBodyCode'
	CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
	WHERE rz.countrycode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
		AND rz.statusCode IN ('valid', 'stable')
		AND sf.includes_spatial = 1
),
swb_sites_ref AS (
	SELECT DISTINCT MR.thematicIdIdentifier AS euMonitoringSiteCode
	FROM dataset_37016."monitoringsitewfd" MR
	JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewfd" rz ON rz.thematicIdIdentifier = MR.relatedzoneidentifier
		AND rz.thematicIdIdentifierScheme = 'euSurfaceWaterBodyCode'
	CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
	WHERE MR.countrycode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
		AND rz.statusCode IN ('valid', 'stable')
		AND sf.includes_spatial = 0
),
all_swb_sites AS (
	SELECT euMonitoringSiteCode FROM swb_sites_spatial
	UNION ALL
	SELECT euMonitoringSiteCode FROM swb_sites_ref
),
-- =========================================================
-- 5. Tag each monitoring record with its water body type.
--    GWB takes precedence if a site appears in both.
-- =========================================================
monitoring_with_bodytype AS (
	SELECT
		M.record_id
		,M."eumonitoringsitecode"
		,M."parametercode"
		,M."chemicalmatrix"
		,CASE WHEN gwb.euMonitoringSiteCode IS NOT NULL THEN 'GWB' ELSE 'SWB' END AS bodytype
	FROM dataset_44489."monitoring" M
	LEFT JOIN all_gwb_sites gwb ON gwb.euMonitoringSiteCode = M."eumonitoringsitecode"
	LEFT JOIN all_swb_sites swb ON swb.euMonitoringSiteCode = M."eumonitoringsitecode"
	WHERE gwb.euMonitoringSiteCode IS NOT NULL
		OR swb.euMonitoringSiteCode IS NOT NULL
)
-- =========================================================
-- RESULT: chemicalMatrix reported if and only if chemical
-- monitoring occurs, per GWB/SWB body type. [R400_WFD]
-- =========================================================
SELECT
	MB.record_id
	,MB."chemicalmatrix"
	,MB."parametercode"
	,MB.bodytype
	,mb."eumonitoringsitecode"
	,PC."isGroundWaterPollutant"
	,PC."isSurfaceWaterPollutant"
FROM monitoring_with_bodytype MB
JOIN dataset_44488."parametercode" PC ON PC."notation" = MB."parametercode"
CROSS JOIN country_check
WHERE (
		-- chemicalMatrix missing but parameter IS chemical for this body type
		COALESCE(MB."chemicalmatrix", '') = ''
		AND (
			(MB.bodytype = 'GWB' AND PC."isGroundWaterPollutant" = '1')
			OR (MB.bodytype = 'SWB' AND PC."isSurfaceWaterPollutant" = '1')
			)
		)
	OR (
		-- chemicalMatrix reported but parameter is NOT chemical for this body type
		COALESCE(MB."chemicalmatrix", '') <> ''
		AND (
			(MB.bodytype = 'GWB' AND PC."isGroundWaterPollutant" = '0')
			OR (MB.bodytype = 'SWB' AND PC."isSurfaceWaterPollutant" = '0')
			)
		)

Message: If, for a given river basin district, the option useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'yes' is reported in the MonitoringProgrammes table, then the monitoring of physico-chemical and chemical parameters must NOT be reported in the Monitoring table. [T405_WFD]
Expression:
-- =========================================================
-- QC4: Validates that RBDs which declared they use Waterbase
-- as their source for monitoring data (useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'yes')
-- have NOT reported any physico-chemical or chemical parameters
-- in the Monitoring table. If they did, those RBDs and the
-- offending monitoring sites are returned as violations.
-- =========================================================
WITH
spatial_flag AS (
    SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN includesspatialdata = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS includes_spatial
    FROM dataset_37014."dcmetadata"
),
-- =========================================================
-- 0. Compute the spatial data flag ONCE.
-- =========================================================

-- =========================================================
-- 1. Identify RBDs that declared Waterbase as their monitoring
--    data source. These RBDs should not have reported any
--    physico-chemical or chemical data in the Monitoring table.
-- =========================================================
rbd_using_waterbase AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT MP.euRBDCode, record_id
    FROM dataset_44489."monitoringprogrammes" MP
    WHERE MP.useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'yes'
),
-- =========================================================
-- 2. Identify monitoring sites that reported physico-chemical
--    or chemical parameters. QE% and EEA_00-01-1 are excluded
--    as they are the always-mandatory parameters.
-- =========================================================
monitoring_reported_physchem AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.eumonitoringsitecode
    FROM dataset_44489."monitoring" m
    WHERE m.parameterCode NOT LIKE 'QE%'
      AND m.parameterCode <> 'EEA_00-01-1'
),
-- =========================================================
-- 3a. For countries NOT reporting spatial data:
--     link monitoring sites to their RBD using the WFD
--     reference dataset.
-- =========================================================
sites_via_reference AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        swb1.relatedzoneidentifier AS euRBDCode,
        mref.thematicIdIdentifier  AS euMonitoringSiteCode
    FROM monitoring_reported_physchem mo
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."monitoringsitewfd" mref
           ON mo.eumonitoringsitecode    = mref.thematicIdIdentifier
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewfd" swb1
           ON mref.relatedzoneidentifier = swb1.thematicIdIdentifier
   CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
    WHERE mref.countrycode               = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
    AND sf.includes_spatial            = 0
      AND swb1.statusCode                IN ('valid', 'stable')  ),
-- =========================================================
-- 3b. For countries reporting spatial data:
--     link monitoring sites to their RBD using the MonitoringSite
--     dataset submitted in the current delivery.
-- =========================================================
sites_via_spatial AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        swb2.relatedzoneidentifier AS euRBDCode,
        mo.eumonitoringsitecode    AS euMonitoringSiteCode
    FROM monitoring_reported_physchem mo
    INNER JOIN dataset_37015."monitoringsite" spatial
           ON mo.eumonitoringsitecode             = spatial.thematicIdIdentifier
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewfd" swb2
           ON spatial.featureofinterestidentifier = swb2.thematicIdIdentifier
    CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
    WHERE swb2.countrycode                        = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
      AND sf.includes_spatial                     = 1
      AND swb2.statusCode                         IN ('valid', 'stable')  
),
-- =========================================================
-- 4. Merge both paths.
--    UNION ALL is safe: branches are mutually exclusive.
-- =========================================================
all_violating_sites AS (
    SELECT euRBDCode, euMonitoringSiteCode FROM sites_via_reference
    UNION ALL
    SELECT euRBDCode, euMonitoringSiteCode FROM sites_via_spatial
)
-- =========================================================
-- RESULT: RBDs that FAIL QC4.
-- An RBD fails if it declared Waterbase as its data source
-- but still reported physico-chemical or chemical monitoring
-- data. Returns each offending RBD and monitoring site pair.
-- =========================================================
SELECT
    r.record_id,
    r.euRBDCode
FROM rbd_using_waterbase r
INNER JOIN all_violating_sites v
        ON r.euRBDCode = v.euRBDCode
ORDER BY r.euRBDCode, v.euMonitoringSiteCode

QC Description: If a monitoring site is associated with a territorialwater, it must NOT report any parameter codes matching -- 'QE1%' or 'QE2%'.
Message: If a monitoring site is associated with a territorialwater, it must NOT report any parameter codes matching -- 'QE1%' or 'QE2%'. [XC413_WFD]
Expression:
-- =========================================================
-- QC: If a monitoring site is associated with a territorial
-- water, it must NOT report any parameter codes matching
-- 'QE1%' or 'QE2%'. Returns all violating monitoring records.
-- =========================================================
WITH
-- =========================================================
-- 0. Compute the spatial data flag ONCE.
--    includes_spatial = 1 if spatial data was submitted,
--    0 otherwise.
-- =========================================================
spatial_flag AS (
    SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN includesspatialdata = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS includes_spatial
    FROM dataset_37014."dcmetadata"
),
-- =========================================================
-- 1. For countries NOT reporting spatial data:
--    identify monitoring sites linked to territorial waters
--    using the WFD reference dataset.
-- =========================================================
territorial_sites_ref AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        mref.thematicIdIdentifier AS euMonitoringSiteCode
    FROM dataset_37016."monitoringsitewfd" mref
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewfd" swb
           ON  mref.relatedzoneidentifier    = swb.thematicIdIdentifier
           AND swb.thematicIdIdentifierScheme = 'euSurfaceWaterBodyCode'
           AND swb.statusCode                IN ('valid', 'stable')
           AND swb.specialisedZoneType       = 'territorialWaters'
    CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
    WHERE mref.countrycode     = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
      AND sf.includes_spatial  = 0
),
-- =========================================================
-- 2. For countries reporting spatial data:
--    identify monitoring sites linked to territorial waters
--    using the MonitoringSite dataset from the current delivery.
-- =========================================================
territorial_sites_spatial AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        spatial.thematicIdIdentifier AS euMonitoringSiteCode
    FROM dataset_37015."monitoringsite" spatial
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewfd" swb
           ON  spatial.featureofinterestidentifier = swb.thematicIdIdentifier
           AND swb.thematicIdIdentifierScheme      = 'euSurfaceWaterBodyCode'
           AND swb.statusCode                      IN ('valid', 'stable')
           AND swb.specialisedZoneType             = 'territorialWaters'
    CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
    WHERE swb.countrycode      = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
      AND sf.includes_spatial  = 1
),
-- =========================================================
-- 3. Merge both paths into a single set of monitoring sites
--    associated with territorial waters.
--    UNION ALL is safe: branches are mutually exclusive.
-- =========================================================
all_territorial_sites AS (
    SELECT euMonitoringSiteCode FROM territorial_sites_ref
    UNION ALL
    SELECT euMonitoringSiteCode FROM territorial_sites_spatial
)
-- =========================================================
-- RESULT: Monitoring records that FAIL this QC.
-- A record fails if its monitoring site is linked to a
-- territorial water AND its parameterCode matches QE1% or QE2%.
-- =========================================================
SELECT
    m.record_id,
    m.euMonitoringSiteCode,
    m.parameterCode
FROM dataset_44489."monitoring" m
INNER JOIN all_territorial_sites t
        ON m.euMonitoringSiteCode = t.euMonitoringSiteCode
WHERE (m.parameterCode LIKE 'QE1%'
    OR m.parameterCode LIKE 'QE2%')
      and exists (
                select  0
                from    dataset_37016."country" C
                where   countryCode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
                        and reportingType = 'WFD'
                )
ORDER BY m.euMonitoringSiteCode, m.parameterCode

Message: If, for a given RBD, useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'no' and there are monitoring sites in Surface Water Bodies, then at least one site MUST report a parameterCode NOT LIKE 'QE%'. [XC411_WFD]
Expression:
-- =========================================================
-- QC1 (SWB): For a given RBD where useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'no',
-- if there are monitoring sites associated with Surface Water Bodies,
-- at least one of them MUST report a parameterCode NOT LIKE 'QE%'.
-- Triggers an error if no such parameter is found.

WITH

    FROM dataset_37014."dcmetadata"
),
rbd_not_using_waterbase AS (

    FROM dataset_44489."monitoringprogrammes" MP
    WHERE MP.useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'no'
),
swb_sites_ref AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        swb.relatedzoneidentifier AS euRBDCode,
        mref.thematicIdIdentifier AS euMonitoringSiteCode
    FROM dataset_44489."monitoring" mo
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."monitoringsitewfd" mref
           ON mo.eumonitoringsitecode             = mref.thematicIdIdentifier
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewfd" swb
           ON mref.relatedzoneidentifier          = swb.thematicIdIdentifier
    CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
    WHERE mref.countrycode                        = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
      AND sf.includes_spatial                     = 0
      AND swb.thematicIdIdentifierScheme          ='euSurfaceWaterBodyCode'
      AND swb.statusCode                          IN ('valid', 'stable')
),
swb_sites_spatial AS (

    FROM dataset_44489."monitoring" mo
    INNER JOIN dataset_37015."monitoringsite" spatial
           ON mo.eumonitoringsitecode               = spatial.thematicIdIdentifier
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewfd" swb
           ON spatial.featureofinterestidentifier   = swb.thematicIdIdentifier
    CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
    WHERE swb.countrycode                           = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
      AND sf.includes_spatial                       = 1
      AND swb.thematicIdIdentifierScheme            ='euSurfaceWaterBodyCode'
      AND swb.statusCode                            IN ('valid', 'stable')
),
all_swb_sites AS (
    SELECT euRBDCode, euMonitoringSiteCode FROM swb_sites_ref
    UNION ALL
    SELECT euRBDCode, euMonitoringSiteCode FROM swb_sites_spatial
),
-- ✅ Only NOT LIKE 'QE%' — no EEA_00-01-1 exclusion for SWB
rbds_reporting_physchem AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.euRBDCode
    FROM all_swb_sites s
    INNER JOIN dataset_44489."monitoring" m
           ON s.euMonitoringSiteCode = m.eumonitoringsitecode

)

QC Description: If, for a given RBD where useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'no', if there are monitoring sites associated with Groundwater Bodies, at least one of them MUST report a parameterCode != 'EEA_00-01-1'.
Message: If, for a given RBD where useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'no', if there are monitoring sites associated with Groundwater Bodies, at least one of them MUST report a parameterCode != 'EEA_00-01-1'. [XC412_WFD]
Expression:
-- =========================================================
-- QC2 (GWB): For a given RBD where useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'no',
-- if there are monitoring sites associated with Groundwater Bodies,
-- at least one of them MUST report a parameterCode <> 'EEA_00-01-1'.
-- Triggers an error if ALL sites only report 'EEA_00-01-1' and
-- none report any additional physico-chemical parameter.
-- =========================================================
WITH
-- =========================================================
-- 0. Compute the spatial data flag ONCE.
-- =========================================================
spatial_flag AS (
    SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN includesspatialdata = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS includes_spatial
    FROM dataset_37014."dcmetadata"
),
-- =========================================================
-- 1. RBDs that declared they do NOT use Waterbase.
--    These are the only RBDs in scope for this QC.
-- =========================================================
rbd_not_using_waterbase AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT MP.euRBDCode, MP.record_id
    FROM dataset_44489."monitoringprogrammes" MP
    WHERE MP.useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'no'
),
-- =========================================================
-- 2a. For countries NOT reporting spatial data:
--     identify monitoring sites linked to GWBs
--     using the WFD reference dataset.
-- =========================================================
gwb_sites_ref AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        swb.relatedzoneidentifier AS euRBDCode,
        mref.thematicIdIdentifier AS euMonitoringSiteCode
    FROM dataset_44489."monitoring" mo
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."monitoringsitewfd" mref
           ON mo.eumonitoringsitecode             = mref.thematicIdIdentifier
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewfd" swb
           ON mref.relatedzoneidentifier          = swb.thematicIdIdentifier
    CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
    WHERE mref.countrycode                        = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
      AND sf.includes_spatial                     = 0
      AND swb.thematicIdIdentifierScheme           = 'euGroundWaterBodyCode'
      AND swb.statusCode                          IN ('valid', 'stable')
),
-- =========================================================
-- 2b. For countries reporting spatial data:
--     identify monitoring sites linked to GWBs
--     using the MonitoringSite dataset from current delivery.
-- =========================================================
gwb_sites_spatial AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        swb.relatedzoneidentifier    AS euRBDCode,
        spatial.thematicIdIdentifier AS euMonitoringSiteCode
    FROM dataset_44489."monitoring" mo
    INNER JOIN dataset_37015."monitoringsite" spatial
           ON mo.eumonitoringsitecode               = spatial.thematicIdIdentifier
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewfd" swb
           ON spatial.featureofinterestidentifier   = swb.thematicIdIdentifier
    CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
    WHERE swb.countrycode                           = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
      AND sf.includes_spatial                       = 1
      AND swb.thematicIdIdentifierScheme            = 'euGroundWaterBodyCode'
      AND swb.statusCode                            IN ('valid', 'stable')
),
-- =========================================================
-- 3. Merge both paths.
--    UNION ALL is safe: branches are mutually exclusive.
-- =========================================================
all_gwb_sites AS (
    SELECT euRBDCode, euMonitoringSiteCode FROM gwb_sites_ref
    UNION ALL
    SELECT euRBDCode, euMonitoringSiteCode FROM gwb_sites_spatial
),
-- =========================================================
-- 4. Among the GWB sites, find RBDs that DO have at least
--    one site reporting a parameterCode <> 'EEA_00-01-1'.
--    These are the RBDs that PASS the QC.
--    Note: EEA_00-01-1 alone is not sufficient — at least one
--    additional physico-chemical parameter must be reported.
-- =========================================================
rbds_reporting_non_eea AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.euRBDCode
    FROM all_gwb_sites s
    INNER JOIN dataset_44489."monitoring" m
           ON s.euMonitoringSiteCode = m.eumonitoringsitecode
    WHERE m.parameterCode <> 'EEA_00-01-1'  -- at least one non-EEA parameter
)
-- =========================================================
-- RESULT: RBDs that FAIL QC2.
-- Conditions for failure:
--   1. useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'no'
--   2. Has at least one GWB monitoring site
--   3. None of those sites report a parameterCode <> 'EEA_00-01-1'
-- =========================================================
SELECT
    r.record_id,
    r.euRBDCode
FROM rbd_not_using_waterbase r
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT euRBDCode FROM all_gwb_sites) s
        ON r.euRBDCode = s.euRBDCode
LEFT JOIN rbds_reporting_non_eea q
        ON r.euRBDCode = q.euRBDCode
WHERE q.euRBDCode IS NULL and exists (
                select  0
                from    dataset_37016."country" C
                where   countryCode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
                        and reportingType = 'WFD'
                )
ORDER BY r.euRBDCode

QC Description: If a monitoring site is associated with a territorialwater, it must NOT report any parameter codes matching -- 'QE1%' or 'QE2%'.
Message: If a monitoring site is associated with a territorialwater, it must NOT report any parameter codes matching -- 'QE1%' or 'QE2%'. [XC413_WISE5]
Expression:
-- =========================================================
-- QC: If a monitoring site is associated with a territorial
-- water, it must NOT report any parameter codes matching
-- 'QE1%' or 'QE2%'. Returns all violating monitoring records.
-- =========================================================
WITH
-- =========================================================
-- 0. Compute the spatial data flag ONCE.
--    includes_spatial = 1 if spatial data was submitted,
--    0 otherwise.
-- =========================================================
spatial_flag AS (
    SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN includesspatialdata = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS includes_spatial
    FROM dataset_37014."dcmetadata"
),
-- =========================================================
-- 1. For countries NOT reporting spatial data:
--    identify monitoring sites linked to territorial waters
--    using the WFD reference dataset.
-- =========================================================
territorial_sites_ref AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        mref.thematicIdIdentifier AS euMonitoringSiteCode
    FROM dataset_37016."monitoringsitewise5" mref
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewise5" swb
           ON  mref.relatedzoneidentifier     = swb.thematicIdIdentifier
           AND swb.thematicIdIdentifierScheme = 'euSurfaceWaterBodyCode'
           AND swb.statusCode                 IN ('valid', 'stable')
           AND swb.specialisedZoneType        = 'territorialWaters'
    CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
    WHERE mref.countrycode    = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
      AND sf.includes_spatial = 0
),
-- =========================================================
-- 2. For countries reporting spatial data:
--    identify monitoring sites linked to territorial waters
--    using the MonitoringSite dataset from the current delivery.
-- =========================================================
territorial_sites_spatial AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        spatial.thematicIdIdentifier AS euMonitoringSiteCode
    FROM dataset_37015."monitoringsite" spatial
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewise5" swb
           ON  spatial.featureofinterestidentifier = swb.thematicIdIdentifier
           AND swb.thematicIdIdentifierScheme      = 'euSurfaceWaterBodyCode'
           AND swb.statusCode                      IN ('valid', 'stable')
           AND swb.specialisedZoneType             = 'territorialWaters'
    CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
    WHERE swb.countrycode     = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
      AND sf.includes_spatial = 1
),
-- =========================================================
-- 3. Merge both paths into a single set of monitoring sites
--    associated with territorial waters.
--    UNION ALL is safe: branches are mutually exclusive.
-- =========================================================
all_territorial_sites AS (
    SELECT euMonitoringSiteCode FROM territorial_sites_ref
    UNION ALL
    SELECT euMonitoringSiteCode FROM territorial_sites_spatial
)
-- =========================================================
-- RESULT: Monitoring records that FAIL this QC.
-- A record fails if its monitoring site is linked to a
-- territorial water AND its parameterCode matches QE1% or QE2%.
-- =========================================================
SELECT
    m.record_id,
    m.euMonitoringSiteCode,
    m.parameterCode
FROM dataset_44489."monitoring" m
INNER JOIN all_territorial_sites t
        ON m.euMonitoringSiteCode = t.euMonitoringSiteCode
WHERE (m.parameterCode LIKE 'QE1%'
    OR m.parameterCode LIKE 'QE2%')
      AND EXISTS (
                SELECT 0
                FROM dataset_37016."country" C
                WHERE countryCode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
                  AND reportingType = 'WISE5'
                )
ORDER BY m.euMonitoringSiteCode, m.parameterCode

QC Description: If, for a given RBD where useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'no', if there are monitoring sites associated with Groundwater Bodies, at least one of them MUST report a parameterCode != 'EEA_00-01-1'.
Message: If, for a given RBD where useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'no', if there are monitoring sites associated with Groundwater Bodies, at least one of them MUST report a parameterCode != 'EEA_00-01-1'. [XC412_WISE5]
Expression:
-- =========================================================
-- QC2 (GWB): For a given RBD where useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'no',
-- if there are monitoring sites associated with Groundwater Bodies,
-- at least one of them MUST report a parameterCode <> 'EEA_00-01-1'.
-- Triggers an error if ALL sites only report 'EEA_00-01-1' and
-- none report any additional physico-chemical parameter.
-- =========================================================
WITH
-- =========================================================
-- 0. Compute the spatial data flag ONCE.
-- =========================================================
spatial_flag AS (
    SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN includesspatialdata = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS includes_spatial
    FROM dataset_37014."dcmetadata"
),
-- =========================================================
-- 1. RBDs that declared they do NOT use Waterbase.
--    These are the only RBDs in scope for this QC.
-- =========================================================
rbd_not_using_waterbase AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT MP.euRBDCode, MP.record_id
    FROM dataset_44489."monitoringprogrammes" MP
    WHERE MP.useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'no'
),
-- =========================================================
-- 2a. For countries NOT reporting spatial data:
--     identify monitoring sites linked to GWBs
--     using the WFD reference dataset.
-- =========================================================
gwb_sites_ref AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        swb.relatedzoneidentifier AS euRBDCode,
        mref.thematicIdIdentifier AS euMonitoringSiteCode
    FROM dataset_44489."monitoring" mo
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."monitoringsitewise5" mref
           ON mo.eumonitoringsitecode             = mref.thematicIdIdentifier
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewise5" swb
           ON mref.relatedzoneidentifier          = swb.thematicIdIdentifier
    CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
    WHERE mref.countrycode                        = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
      AND sf.includes_spatial                     = 0
      AND swb.thematicIdIdentifierScheme          = 'eionetGroundWaterBodyCode'
      AND swb.statusCode                          IN ('valid', 'stable')
),
-- =========================================================
-- 2b. For countries reporting spatial data:
--     identify monitoring sites linked to GWBs
--     using the MonitoringSite dataset from current delivery.
-- =========================================================
gwb_sites_spatial AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        swb.relatedzoneidentifier    AS euRBDCode,
        spatial.thematicIdIdentifier AS euMonitoringSiteCode
    FROM dataset_44489."monitoring" mo
    INNER JOIN dataset_37015."monitoringsite" spatial
           ON mo.eumonitoringsitecode               = spatial.thematicIdIdentifier
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewise5" swb
           ON spatial.featureofinterestidentifier   = swb.thematicIdIdentifier
    CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
    WHERE swb.countrycode                           = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
      AND sf.includes_spatial                       = 1
      AND swb.thematicIdIdentifierScheme            = 'eionetGroundWaterBodyCode'
      AND swb.statusCode                            IN ('valid', 'stable')
),
-- =========================================================
-- 3. Merge both paths.
--    UNION ALL is safe: branches are mutually exclusive.
-- =========================================================
all_gwb_sites AS (
    SELECT euRBDCode, euMonitoringSiteCode FROM gwb_sites_ref
    UNION ALL
    SELECT euRBDCode, euMonitoringSiteCode FROM gwb_sites_spatial
),
-- =========================================================
-- 4. Among the GWB sites, find RBDs that DO have at least
--    one site reporting a parameterCode <> 'EEA_00-01-1'.
--    These are the RBDs that PASS the QC.
--    Note: EEA_00-01-1 alone is not sufficient — at least one
--    additional physico-chemical parameter must be reported.
-- =========================================================
rbds_reporting_non_eea AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.euRBDCode
    FROM all_gwb_sites s
    INNER JOIN dataset_44489."monitoring" m
           ON s.euMonitoringSiteCode = m.eumonitoringsitecode
    WHERE m.parameterCode <> 'EEA_00-01-1'
)
-- =========================================================
-- RESULT: RBDs that FAIL QC2.
-- Conditions for failure:
--   1. useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'no'
--   2. Has at least one GWB monitoring site
--   3. None of those sites report a parameterCode <> 'EEA_00-01-1'
-- =========================================================
SELECT
    r.record_id,
    r.euRBDCode
FROM rbd_not_using_waterbase r
INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT euRBDCode FROM all_gwb_sites) s
        ON r.euRBDCode = s.euRBDCode
LEFT JOIN rbds_reporting_non_eea q
        ON r.euRBDCode = q.euRBDCode
WHERE q.euRBDCode IS NULL
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 0
        FROM dataset_37016."country" C
        WHERE countryCode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
          AND reportingType = 'WISE5'
    )
ORDER BY r.euRBDCode

QC Description: The MonitoringPurpose table must have one record for each of the monitoringsites  being reported for the RBD where includesMonitoringData='yes'. Values: {%identifiers%} . Number of invalid values: {%numberofrecords%}
Message: The MonitoringPurpose table must have one record for each of the monitoringsites  being reported for the RBD where includesMonitoringData='yes'. Values: {%identifiers%} . Number of invalid values: {%numberofrecords%}  [T402_WISE5]

-- RESULT: For GWB sites with chemical monitoring, chemicalMatrix

-- sites where chemicalMatrix is missing or not 'water'. [R402_WFD]
-- =========================================================
SELECT
	M.record_id,
	M."chemicalmatrix",
	M."parametercode"
FROM dataset_44489."monitoring" M
JOIN all_gwb_sites gs
	ON gs.euMonitoringSiteCode = M."eumonitoringsitecode"
JOIN dataset_44488."parametercode" PC
	ON PC."notation" = M."parametercode"
CROSS JOIN country_check
WHERE PC."isGroundWaterPollutant" = '1'
	AND COALESCE(M."chemicalmatrix", '') <> 'water'

Message: If, for a given river basin district, the option useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'yes' is reported in the MonitoringProgrammes table, then the monitoring of physico-chemical and chemical parameters must NOT be reported in the Monitoring table. [T405_WISE5]
Expression:
-- =========================================================
-- QC4: Validates that RBDs which declared they use Waterbase
-- as their source for monitoring data (useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'yes')
-- have NOT reported any physico-chemical or chemical parameters
-- in the Monitoring table. If they did, those RBDs and the
-- offending monitoring sites are returned as violations.
-- =========================================================
WITH
spatial_flag AS (
    SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN includesspatialdata = 'yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS includes_spatial
    FROM dataset_37014."dcmetadata"
),
-- =========================================================
-- 0. Compute the spatial data flag ONCE.
-- =========================================================

-- =========================================================
-- 1. Identify RBDs that declared Waterbase as their monitoring
--    data source. These RBDs should not have reported any
--    physico-chemical or chemical data in the Monitoring table.
-- =========================================================
rbd_using_waterbase AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT MP.euRBDCode, record_id
    FROM dataset_44489."monitoringprogrammes" MP
    WHERE MP.useWaterbaseForMonitoringData = 'yes'
),
-- =========================================================
-- 2. Identify monitoring sites that reported physico-chemical
--    or chemical parameters. QE% and EEA_00-01-1 are excluded
--    as they are the always-mandatory parameters.
-- =========================================================
monitoring_reported_physchem AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.eumonitoringsitecode
    FROM dataset_44489."monitoring" m
    WHERE m.parameterCode NOT LIKE 'QE%'
      AND m.parameterCode <> 'EEA_00-01-1'
),
-- =========================================================
-- 3a. For countries NOT reporting spatial data:
--     link monitoring sites to their RBD using the reference dataset.
-- =========================================================
sites_via_reference AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        swb1.relatedzoneidentifier AS euRBDCode,
        mref.thematicIdIdentifier  AS euMonitoringSiteCode
    FROM monitoring_reported_physchem mo
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."monitoringsitewise5" mref
           ON mo.eumonitoringsitecode = mref.thematicIdIdentifier
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewise5" swb1
           ON mref.relatedzoneidentifier = swb1.thematicIdIdentifier
    CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
    WHERE mref.countrycode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
      AND sf.includes_spatial = 0
      AND swb1.statusCode IN ('valid', 'stable')
),
-- =========================================================
-- 3b. For countries reporting spatial data:
--     link monitoring sites to their RBD using the MonitoringSite
--     dataset submitted in the current delivery.
-- =========================================================
sites_via_spatial AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        swb2.relatedzoneidentifier AS euRBDCode,
        mo.eumonitoringsitecode    AS euMonitoringSiteCode
    FROM monitoring_reported_physchem mo
    INNER JOIN dataset_37015."monitoringsite" spatial
           ON mo.eumonitoringsitecode = spatial.thematicIdIdentifier
    INNER JOIN dataset_37016."relatedzonewise5" swb2
           ON spatial.featureofinterestidentifier = swb2.thematicIdIdentifier
    CROSS JOIN spatial_flag sf
    WHERE swb2.countrycode = '{%R3_COUNTRY_CODE%}'
      AND sf.includes_spatial = 1
      AND swb2.statusCode IN ('valid', 'stable')
),
-- =========================================================
-- 4. Merge both paths.
--    UNION ALL is safe: branches are mutually exclusive.
-- =========================================================
all_violating_sites AS (
    SELECT euRBDCode, euMonitoringSiteCode FROM sites_via_reference
    UNION ALL
    SELECT euRBDCode, euMonitoringSiteCode FROM sites_via_spatial
)
-- =========================================================
-- RESULT: RBDs that FAIL QC4.
-- An RBD fails if it declared Waterbase as its data source
-- but still reported physico-chemical or chemical monitoring
-- data. Returns each offending RBD and monitoring site pair.
-- =========================================================
SELECT
    r.record_id,
    r.euRBDCode
FROM rbd_using_waterbase r
INNER JOIN all_violating_sites v
        ON r.euRBDCode = v.euRBDCode
ORDER BY r.euRBDCode, v.euMonitoringSiteCode
